    of Seville, and others)

Publisher: Paris, Migne (the host's date field reads 1800, a placeholder; a Toronto copy with a
    1878 imprint)
Rights: Public Domain
Rights basis: 1878 publication, out of US copyright by date; the item carries no copyright field of
    its own, so the imprint date is the basis, read directly 2026-10-23. The host's date
    field reads 1800 (a placeholder); Migne's Patrologia Latina volumes were printed
    between 1844 and 1878, so before 1930 on any reading.
Language: lat
Source: Internet Archive item patrologiaecur72mign (archive.org/details/patrologiaecur72mign),
    fetched directly (curl, raw bytes) from the item's own _djvu.txt full-text file,

Provenance note: Raw, uncorrected djvu OCR (rough but readable). Runs of 2+ spaces collapsed to one; no
    wording changed. Sections: Migne columns; Leander's Regula (Liber de institutione
    virginum) at raw line ~85910; his Homilia in laudem Ecclesiae at ~66727. Credit line
    for a reader-facing page: "Patrologia Latina 72 (Migne)". Whole text republishable.
Content note: The architect of Reccared's conversion, Leander of Seville: his rule for virgins and
    his homily on the church delivered after Toledo III. No public-domain English exists.

Exc oratio post litaniam canitur. 
Magniflcis mirificisque orationibus atque merilis recensitorum patriarcharum, prophetarum atque 
apostolorum, plurimorumque martjrum, vel elcctorum, atque confessorum omnium, petimusetoramus, 
ut quemadmodum eorum nomina vel memoriam in hoc saeculo memorare et recitare frequentamus, ita 
atque ipsi pro nobis in regnis cojlestibus affectuales ac privatas preces fundere dignentur, ut a Deo 
veniam et indulgentiam impetrare alquc obtinere, et eorum desiderandam et aspiciendam speciem et 
gloriam in regno Dei videre, et congaudere mereamur, prajstante Domino nostro Jesu Christo, cui est 
honor, et potestas, et imperium una cum Patre atque Spiritu sancto in seecula saeculorum. Amen.
